checks.name: Rendered compact Fight and default keyboard guidance explain complete sword sequence

fight.text: FightWith a sword, press Swing for a light swing. Keep holding through that swing and its recovery to start charging, then release Swing for a heavy. A heavy normally takes one heart, flings knights further and breaks guard; fill the charge arc for extra reach. With a pickup weapon, Swing fires it. Block stops swords and bounces arrows back; block just as they swing to parry and stun them. Holding block drains your guard. Swing while blocking to shield-bash. Dash hops pits and dodges; attack right after a dash for a stab. Knights get flung further the more hurt they are. Three hearts and you're out for a couple of seconds.

guidance.text: FightWith a sword, press Swing for a light swing. Keep holding through that swing and its recovery to start charging, then release Swing for a heavy. A heavy normally takes one heart, flings knights further and breaks guard; fill the charge arc for extra reach. With a pickup weapon, Swing fires it.

keyboard.text: Solo keyboard: Move: W / Up arrow, A / Left arrow, S / Down arrow, D / Right arrow · Swing: Space / J / F · Dash: Left Shift / Right Shift / K / G · Block: E / L / H. Mouse aims, left click swings or fires, right click blocks. Keyboard half 1: Move: W, A, S, D · Swing: F · Dash: G · Block: H. Keyboard half 2: Move: Up arrow, Left arrow, Down arrow, Right arrow · Swing: J · Dash: K · Block: L. Sword: press Swing for a light swing; keep holding through its recovery to charge, then release for a heavy. Pickup weapons: Swing fires. Shout 1-4 / 7-0. Escape / P opens the match menu.
